PlayOne uses it to pitch their store and reassure shoppers, while Toys R Us has nothing there at all. A canonical tag is like an address label that tells Google exactly which version of a website is the real, official one. Without it, Google can get confused between multiple versions of the same site and may split its attention — quietly reducing how prominently Toys R Us ranks.
